text:
The median asking rent in Duisburg stands at 8.49 €/m², up 4.9 % year‑on‑year and 27.6 % over the last five years, placing the city 34th of the 37 most expensive German markets. Asking rents are about 45 % above the 2022 existing‑rent level of 5.84 €/m², and a 60 m² unit costs roughly 509 € per month.

Market tightness is moderate: the vacancy rate is 2.4 % and days on market average 35, with 19 % of listings let within a week. Rent‑burden for two residents is 14.5 %, while the market balance is described as balanced.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 8.95 €/m² in 12 months, ranging from 8.71 €/m² to 9.08 €/m², implying a 5.4 % increase.
